title: Section 4 — Inventories & equipment
description: Inventory or equipment of a player or of a world object (building, machine…). Domain key: id. May be referenced by Player.inventoryId, Player.equipmentId or WorldObject.siIds. Only inventories referenced by a player are filtered out when players are merged.

id.description: Unique identifier of the inventory (referenced by Player.inventoryId or Player.equipmentId)

woIds.description: CSV ids of the world objects held in the inventory ('' when empty). → Section 3 WorldObject.id

size.description: Maximum capacity of the inventory (number of slots)

demandGrps.description: (optional) Demand groups for automatic logistic trading

supplyGrps.description: (optional) Supply groups for automatic logistic trading
